title: Reproducing Tsai et al. 1987: trap density after nitridation in ammonia

sample.ours: FAMILY: Si_Planar; ORIENTATION: Si100; DOPING: n_type_15_25_ohm_cm (recorded; no program reads it)

sample.paper: “The gate oxide with a thickness of 250 A was grown by dry O2 oxidation at 920 C”
sample.note: The time is chosen to give 25 nm with the thin-oxide program.

sample.ours: no field: the oxide is SiO2 in every program
sample.note: Nitrogen content and profile are not measured in the paper either; the authors speak of a “degree of nitridation”.

sample.paper: LPCVD polysilicon, about 4500 Å, arsenic implanted; p+ boron ring at the gate edge
sample.ours: GATE: n_plus_polysilicon_As (recorded; no program reads it)
sample.note: The gate sets the work-function difference in the flat-band voltage; no program computes a flat-band voltage.

history.paper: “the conventional polysilicon-gate self-aligned MOS process including local oxidation (LOCOS) technique”
history.note: The field oxidation's temperature and time, and the clean before the gate oxide, are not stated.

history.item: Gate oxidation, dry O2, 920 °C, to 250 Å
history.paper: “The gate oxide with a thickness of 250 A was grown by dry O2 oxidation at 920 C”
history.ours: RUN Oxidation DURATION 4200 TEMP 920->920 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: The time is not stated; 70 min is what the thin-oxide program needs for 25 nm at 920 °C. Load, push and ramp are not stated either.

history.paper: “and in-situ annealed at the same temperature in N2 ambient for 30 min.”
history.ours: RUN NitrogenAnneal DURATION 1800 TEMP 920->920 AMBIENT inert_N2

history.paper: “A LPCVD polysilicon layer of about 4500 A was deposited”
history.note: Temperature and time not stated (LPCVD polysilicon is usually 600 to 650 °C from silane, which carries hydrogen).

history.paper: “and then doped by arsenic ion implantation.”

history.ours: RUN DriveIn DURATION 1800 TEMP 1000->1000 AMBIENT inert_N2
history.note: 30 min in nitrogen is ours; ramps not written.

history.item: Gate lithography and self-aligned boron implant, 2×10^15 cm⁻² at 30 keV
history.paper: “a self-aligned implantation of boron ions with a dose of 2 x 10^15 cm-2 at 30 keV were carried out”
history.note: Double photoresist keeps the boron out of the gate.
Temperature, thickness and precursor not stated.

history.paper: “all wafers were reflowed at 1038 C for 30 min to obtain a smooth surface morphology”
history.ours: RUN Reflow DURATION 1800 TEMP 1038->1038 AMBIENT inert_N2
history.note: The gas is not stated; nitrogen is ours. Ramps not written.

history.paper: “The process steps including contact etching, metallization,”

history.item: Forming gas anneal, 430 °C (time and H2 fraction not stated)
history.paper: “and forming gas annealing at 430 C were then performed”
history.ours: RUN FormingGas DURATION 1800 TEMP 430->430 AMBIENT forming_gas_H2

history.item: Trap density and flat-band voltage, then constant-current stress
history.paper: “The fabricated MIS capacitors were first measured for the interface state density and the flat-band voltage, and then stressed with a constant current density”
history.ours: the observables Dit and (no program) Vfb
history.note: Stress: substrate injection at 10 mA/cm² (nitrided) or 1 mA/cm² (pure oxide). The language has no electrical-stress step.

history.paper: Constant current, substrate injection, 10 mA/cm² (nitrided) and 1 mA/cm² (pure oxide), to fluences of about 4×10^18 cm⁻²
history.ours: EVENT Measure (no stress statement in the language)
history.note: Figure 1 and 2 are measured during this stress; the language and the predictor have no electrical stress.

cases.label: Pure SiO2, 250 Å, not nitrided
cases.note: The paper lists 0 h among the nitridation times; whether the pure-oxide wafers went into the nitridation furnace is not stated, so they are written without it.
